fold.quote: Simply remove the seat, fold the handlebars flat, and undo the quick release lever to fold the frame. As the frame folds, the rear wheel pivots to fit flat between the front wheels. The C.F.T fold allows the trike to be folded in under 30 seconds and works with ICE accessories. You can even fold the trike with our Shimano STEPS motor system fitted.
The ICE Sprint X Tour features a compact folding mechanism, making it easy to store or transport wherever your adventure takes you. ⟶ ✅ Touring-Friendly Design with a 20-Inch Rear Wheel

notes: Recumbent trike, built to order. Maker product page headline 'PRICES FROM: £3,100 | $4,500 | €3,350' is the non-assist trike; e-assist price from the maker's 2026 USD price list PDF (read in-browser via pdf.js; quote is extracted text with double spaces). Maker gives no range figure and sizes by X-seam (35"-50"; Sprint X Pixel 32"-41"), not height. Weight is the lightest non-assist build. Independent source Industrial Bicycles is a dealer that also offers third-party motor kits (EBO 350W, CYC 750W with throttle) besides the Shimano STEPS option; only its Shimano/frame lines were used. Laid Back Cycles' Sprint X Tour E-Assist page has no specs; Hostel Shoppe's Sprint X Tour EP801 listing redirects to a collection page.
